data.narrative:
Drafter is a Seed-stage robotics and manufacturing company founded by Chris Barton and Peter Atkin. The target has raised $3M+ to date. The relevant comp universe consists of 9 private robotics firms (including Walden Robotics, Divergent, Exotec, Locus Robotics, and Generalist AI) and 1 public peer, though narrow peer filtering by stage and valuation tier yielded insufficient same-stage comparables for robust median benchmarking.

Given data constraints, valuation relies on stage-progression methodology. Using the $3M raised as a proxy for current value and applying a typical 2.5x step-up multiplier from Seed to next stage yields an implied valuation of $8M. This reflects standard progression economics in venture-backed hardware, absent direct peer-median validation.

The analysis supports a valuation range of $6M–$9M, with $8M as the central estimate. Key uncertainties include the absence of traction metrics (revenue, unit deployment, customer commitments), which typically anchor hardware valuations in this sector, and the thin peer set available at identical stage and valuation tier. Any material customer validation or operational milestones would merit recalibration upward; conversely, extended cash-burn or technical setbacks would suggest downside pressure. The single applicable method limits confidence in this range and warrants revisiting as comparable data emerges.
